preconditions.description: The number of elements in the sequence is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each element in the sequence is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output string has exactly n characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '123' for c in output)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string is either '1', '2', or '3'.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == '1' if a_i belongs to no longest increasing subsequences else output[i] == '2' if a_i belongs to at least one but not every longest increasing subsequence else output[i] == '3' if a_i belongs to every longest increasing subsequence
postconditions.description: The output string correctly categorizes each index i based on the membership of a_i in the longest increasing subsequences.
